form:FormGroup.label: Classification
form:FormGroup.helpText: The classification or protective marking of the data in this feed, e.g. OFFICIAL. It is shown in upper case when the data is viewed.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Shown in upper case when viewing the feed's data.

form:FormGroup.helpText: Tick if this feed contains reference data, used for reference data lookups.

form:FormGroup.label: Feed Status
form:FormGroup.helpText: What happens to data sent to this feed: Receive, Reject or Drop. Only applies when receiptCheckMode is FEED_STATUS (the default); otherwise this is disabled. Default is Receive.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Receive, Reject or Drop. Disabled unless receipt checking uses feed status.

form:FormGroup.label: Received Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The stream type that will be assigned to received data.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stream type given to received data, e.g. Raw Events.

form:FormGroup.label: Data Encoding
form:FormGroup.helpText: The character encoding of the data part of raw streams received into this feed. Default is UTF-8.

form:FormGroup.label: Context Encoding
form:FormGroup.helpText: The character encoding of the context part of streams received into this feed. Default is UTF-8.

form:FormGroup.label: Data Format
form:FormGroup.helpText: The format of the data part of streams received into this feed, e.g. XML, JSON or CSV.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: For example XML, JSON or CSV.

form:FormGroup.label: Context Format
form:FormGroup.helpText: The format of the context part of streams received into this feed, e.g. XML, JSON or CSV.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: For example XML, JSON or CSV.

form:FormGroup.label: Data Schema
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name of the schema that the data conforms to, if applicable.

form:FormGroup.label: Data Schema Version
form:FormGroup.helpText: The version of the schema that the data conforms to, if applicable.

form:FormGroup.label: Volume Group
form:FormGroup.helpText: The volume group that this feed's data is stored in. Leave blank to use the default volume group.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Leave blank to use the default volume group.
